objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with a breast mass.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hello, I’m 33 and currently 17 weeks pregnant. About three weeks ago I noticed a painless lump in my right breast, and it hasn’t changed since then. I haven’t had any fever, nipple discharge, or any skin changes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any scratched or rubbed-raw areas, and no small open spots or excoriations on the breast skin. The only thing I’ve observed is the painless lump on the right side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone tells you, or you wake up gasping)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any episodes where I stop breathing, pause breathing, or wake up gasping during sleep. I haven’t been told I snore loudly or that I have breathing pauses.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, obvious swelling or bruising, deformity, or trouble using the area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any injury or signs like severe pain, swelling or bruising, deformity, or trouble using the right breast area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist—I haven’t had any symptoms there.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored skin on the chest), especially after an injury, coughing, or strain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising or dark discoloration on my chest wall. I also haven’t had any recent injury, intense coughing, or straining that could cause bruising.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—either needing to go to the bathroom more often or passing larger amounts each time?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed urinating more often or passing larger amounts than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances that could affect your health—such as alcohol, tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs—either recently or in the past?
turns.patient_answer: “Since becoming pregnant and before that, I don’t smoke or use any nicotine, I don’t drink alcohol, and I haven’t used cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or any other drugs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I've had normal bladder control, with no leaking or trouble making it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin lesion—such as a new spot, sore, bump, mole change, or an area that’s not healing? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin lesions—no new spots, sores, bumps, or mole changes, and nothing that hasn’t been healing.”

turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds or any bleeding from my nose recently.”

turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—no rash on my chest, back, or belly. The only issue I’ve noticed is the painless lump in my right breast.”

turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in my legs—no varicose veins around my calves or ankles, and I don’t have leg swelling or pain.”
